`model.py` and `util.py` are `prescient/train/model.py` and `prescient/train/util.py` from the `prescient` 0.1.0 wheel
(github.com/gifford-lab/prescient; Yeo, Saksena and Gifford, Nature Communications 2021), MIT License as declared in the
package metadata. They are copied unchanged so that the training loop can run on in-memory arrays.
